Product Owner – Port Automation Solution

Jobbeskrivelse

Do you want to own and drive a critical digital solution that delivers real, measurable impact? Scandlines is looking for a Product Owner (PO) for our Port Automation Solution.

As Product Owner for the Port Automation Solution, you will set direction, drive priorities, and ensure the solution creates tangible value for Scandlines’ customers, operations, and the wider organization.

You will act as the key link between business needs, operational realities, and technical delivery — turning strategy into concrete outcomes. With a strong focus on user value and continuous improvement, you will play a pivotal role in shaping a solution that is both forward-looking and firmly grounded in day-to-day operations.

Scandlines is a modern and innovative ferry operator, running two high-capacity, high-frequency routes with a green ambition for the future. At Scandlines we want to provide the best break on the journey for both passengers and freight customers. The Port Automation Solution has today been rolled out in our Rødby – Puttgarden route, and in short term we wish to rollout the solution in the second route (Gedser – Rostock).  This will be one of the first tasks to look at as the new PO.

As part of the role, you will be functional team leader of the Port Automation Solution team. The team consist of three members situated in both our main office in Havneholmen and in our office in Rostock.

You will report to the Head of Applications & IT Projects within the IT & Automation department.

You will report to the Head of Applications & IT Projects within the IT & Automation department.

Faglige kompetencer

Roadmap and Operational Governance

• Support the roadmap for the Port Automation Solution, ensuring alignment with strategy, operational needs, resources, and stakeholder priorities.

• Create transparency on roadmap status, priorities, dependencies, risks, and decisions, while translating business and user needs into clear product priorities.

• Facilitate operational governance, including prioritisation, escalation, decision-making, action follow-up, and ongoing monitoring of performance, adoption, risks, and improvements.

End-User Input and Requirements Management

• Collect, structure, and evaluate input and requirements from end users and operational stakeholders, and ensure that these are well-documented.

• Facilitate requirement clarification sessions and feedback loops, translating user needs into actionable solution requirements.

• Promote a strong user-centric mindset by actively seeking feedback from those who use, operate, or are otherwise impacted by the solution.

Change Management and Culture

• Drive and support change management activities that enable successful adoption of the Port Automation Solution.

• Develop a holistic view of the change impact across processes, roles, behaviours, governance, culture, and ways of working.

• Engage leaders, end users, and key stakeholders to build understanding, ownership, readiness for change, and a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

Team Leadership

• Act as team leader for the Port Automation Solution group, providing direction, structure, and prioritisation for the team’s work.

• Support team members in understanding priorities, expectations, dependencies, and decision-making processes.

• Ensure clear objectives, agreed ways of working, and a shared understanding of how success will be measured.

Personlige kompetencer

What we are looking for:

We are looking for a candidate with solid experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Owner, Project Lead, or in a similar role within a digital or process-driven environment. You excel at translating business needs and user insights into clear priorities, actionable requirements, and value-driven roadmaps, and you are comfortable driving stakeholder alignment and decision-making.

We do not expect you to have prior formal leadership experience, but we are looking for someone who is ready and motivated to take on that responsibility. You bring strong people skills, a collaborative mindset, and the confidence to engage, influence, and guide others.

07-12-2026

Yderligere oplysninger

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging job in a dynamic organization with high ambitions.

The position is primarily based in Copenhagen (Havneholmen), and regular travel to port facilities and offices is part of the role. We offer a competitive salary based on your qualifications, along with attractive benefits including a pension scheme, health insurance, staff canteen, special leave days and various discount agreements.

jobs.occupation: Maximizing use of fresh grass for dairy cows by combining grazing, zero-grazing, and multispecies swards
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Animal and Veterinary Sciences programme. The position is available from 01 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Research area and project description:

We are seeking a dedicated PhD student for a 3-year position within the topic of dairy production with fresh grass as a main forage source.

The impact of dairy production on environment and climate is of continued importance and interest. Cropping and feeding fresh grass can potentially improve the impact of dairy production on greenhouse gas emissions and nitrogen leakage to surrounding fresh waters.

The project investigates the potential of maximizing fresh grass forage intake to reduce enteric methane emission and increase nitrogen utilization, while maintaining milk production. A series of trials with lactating dairy cows are planned investigating combinations of grazing, zero-grazing, and multispecies swards.

This project offers:

• A unique opportunity to contribute to a more sustainable agriculture and environmental-friendly milk production

• An active and stimulating academic environment with several other PhD students and early career staff

• Access to state-of-the-art research facilities for both barn-housing, grazing, and pasture management for dairy cattle

• Collaboration with a range of research partners

• Collaborative projects that foster innovative thinking and practical implementation

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant university degree (MSc) in Animal Science, Agricultural Science, or related fields.

The candidate is expected to have:

• Understanding of ruminant nutrition and digestion

• Experience with data handling and analysis using at least one software.

• Ability and interest in collaborating across disciplines with project partners.

• Ability to communicate effectively in English.

• Good scientific and writing skills.

Place of employment and place of work:

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Research center Foulum, Blichers allé 20, 8830 Tjele, Denmark.

jobs.description:
Senior Simulation Engineer – Finite Element Analysis

Hillerød, Denmark

Are you interested in using simulation to develop medical devices that help deliver treatments to patients worldwide? We are looking for an experienced Senior Simulation Engineer specializing in finite element analysis (FEA) to join our team in Hillerød and support the development and maintenance of drug delivery solutions.

Your new role

As our Senior Simulation Engineer, you will take technical ownership of structural simulation activities, helping teams develop reliable products and make informed design decisions. You will work across the product lifecycle, from evaluating early design concepts to supporting validation, product improvements and failure investigations.

Your main responsibilities include:

• Lead finite element analyses: Independently plan and execute structural simulations, selecting appropriate methods to assess performance, durability and safety under realistic loading conditions.

• Build reliable simulation models: Translate engineering requirements and CAD designs into robust models, defining geometry, meshes, material behavior, contacts and boundary conditions. Verify model quality through convergence and sensitivity studies.

• Support design optimization: Collaborate with design and mechanical engineers to improve product performance, material selection and cost. Provide practical recommendations and technical input during design reviews.

• Validate simulations against physical tests: Work with physical test and define validation activities, correlate simulation results with experimental data, assess uncertainty and refine models based on findings.

• Support product development and failure investigations: Contribute structural analysis expertise to cross-functional teams working on new products, product maintenance, validation and root cause analysis.

• Communicate findings clearly: Prepare reports and presentations that explain analysis methods, assumptions, results and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Advance simulation practices and develop colleagues: Improve simulation methods, workflows and standards, contribute to the structural simulation strategy, and mentor junior engineers and interns.

Your new department

You will join Drug Delivery Innovation (DDI), a new area within Novo Nordisk’s global organization, based in Hillerød.

Our team comprises 14 colleagues across three specialist groups: Structural Simulation, Molding Simulation and Material Science. We work closely together and collaborate with stakeholders across Novo Nordisk, combining expertise in simulation and materials to support the development and maintenance of drug delivery solutions.

In this role, you will contribute structural simulation expertise to projects involving design evaluation, test correlation and product improvements. Your findings will help teams assess design options and make decisions throughout development.

Your skills and qualifications

You bring a strong technical foundation and can independently lead complex simulation work, from defining the analysis approach to communicating recommendations that inform design decisions.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• A master’s degree in mechanical engineering, structural engineering, applied mechanics or a related discipline.

• Substantial practical FEA experience, including independent responsibility for complex structural analyses and recommendations.

• The ability to explain technical findings clearly and collaborate effectively with colleagues across design, testing, manufacturing and quality.

• A solid understanding of structural mechanics, material behavior, nonlinear analysis, contact modelling, fatigue and failure mechanisms.

• Experience validating simulation models against experimental data, assessing uncertainty and translating findings into practical design improvements.

Desirable experience

• Modelling of plastics, elastomers, paper and cardboard, including their material behavior and structural response.

• Working in a regulated industry, particularly pharmaceuticals or medical device development.

You take initiative, work systematically and communicate openly with colleagues and stakeholders. You can manage competing priorities as projects evolve and connect detailed technical findings to their implications for product performance and development decisions.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

We are looking for a Project Manager who combines strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the drive, resilience and hands-on approach required to deliver outcomes in complex manufacturing environments.

The position

As a Project Manager, you will work as part of our internal operations and manufacturing consulting team, delivering complex improvement, operational readiness and ramp up projects across our global manufacturing network.

This is not a traditional PMO or project coordination role.

You will be expected to get close to the operation, spend time on the shop floor, understand what is really happening within the production environment and use data and structured problem-solving to identify opportunities for improvement.

More importantly, your responsibility does not end when the solution has been identified. You will work alongside manufacturing teams and stakeholders to turn recommendations into actions and deliver tangible operational outcomes.

Our projects are typically intensive assignments, with project teams substantially dedicated to one project at a time. Assignments will often run for six to twelve months and can sometimes continue for longer.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Working directly with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams to understand operational challenges and identify bottlenecks, losses and improvement opportunities.

• Analysing operational performance data and developing capacity models, process maps and improvement scenarios.

• Translating complex analysis into clear recommendations, practical implementation roadmaps and measurable actions.

• Driving implementation and following improvements through to tangible operational outcomes.

• Working with production teams to establish sustainable changes in performance and ways of working.

• Collaborating with stakeholders across manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain and site leadership.

• Influencing stakeholders and maintaining momentum when implementation is challenging or priorities change.

• Communicating progress, risks, recommendations and outcomes clearly to relevant stakeholders and project leadership.

This is a hands on role. You should be comfortable moving between analytical problem-solving and the realities of implementation on the manufacturing shop floor.

You combine strong intellectual and analytical capability with the practical judgement, resilience and persistence required to turn ideas into results.

• Are comfortable working hands-on with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams.

• Can operate effectively in complex and ambiguous environments where the solution may not initially be obvious.

• Have the resilience and persistence to continue driving change when implementation is difficult or initial solutions do not deliver the expected results.

jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Associate Consumer Finance & Online Partnerships Director, you will build the financial foundation for how Novo grows online partnerships in Obesity across Europe and Canada (EUCAN). This is a newly created role: you will set up a European customer profit and loss view and a clear business case approach, so teams know where to invest and can track the return. You will turn complex analysis into decisions that help more people reach treatment.

What you’ll bring

You thrive where commercial business development, consumer behaviour and financial decision making meet. You can build something new, influence without formal authority and turn complexity into action.

• A master’s degree in economics, business administration, finance or an equivalent field.

• Significant experience in commercial finance, business development, M&A finance, financial system change projects or customer profitability, including cross-country, regional or global exposure.

• Strong financial modelling and data interpretation skills.

• Practical experience in pricing, negotiation, customer profitability and stakeholder management in a large organisation.

• Experience bringing structure to new business areas, setting clear priorities and steering the business through influence and relationships.

• The ability to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations and to build new capabilities, standards and frameworks from the ground up.

• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, AI modelling, SAP and systematic data consolidation.

• Fluency in English.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience from consumer health companies, including private healthcare organisations.

• Additional languages.

What you’ll do

You will be the finance partner who helps Region Europe and Canada decide where to invest in online partnerships and consumer initiatives, and who shows what those investments deliver.

• Create the framework and shape commercial partnership priorities through sound financial modelling, working with business partners to assess partnership opportunities and consumer investment initiatives.

• Develop and deliver a business case methodology across European markets, so investment decisions are prudent, comparable and grounded in facts as part of the business rhythm.

• Establish an end-to-end view of customer and partner profit and loss, including system tracking and performance updates that follow return on investment.

• Deliver complex cross-functional change projects with Business Development, Finance, Legal, Supply Chain and Commercial Strategy to enable online sales in new European markets.

• Act as Commercial Finance Partner to the commercial unit for business development and to the UK affiliate.

• Improve data definitions, ownership, quality and comparability of online sales channels across markets.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Business Finance team in Region Europe and Canada (EUCAN), part of International Operations, reporting to the Director of Business Finance. The team is a key business partner to the Regional Leadership Team and the European sales affiliates.

Day to day, you will collaborate with European sales affiliate offices, local finance and business development teams, and with colleagues in Marketing, Business Development and Commercial Excellence, Data, Insights & Analytics, Pricing and Access, and Supply Chain. You will build bridges between these functions, so every investment decision rests on evidence and aims to maximise patient reach. Working across markets, you will help drive both the online sales agenda and the consumer finance agenda in Obesity.

The role is based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, Denmark.

What you can expect here

You will shape a new area from the start, with the trust to set direction and the visibility to influence decisions across European markets. Working with colleagues from finance, commercial, legal and supply chain, you will broaden your perspective across the value chain and build new skills through practical, cross-functional experience.

You will be supported to perform at your best, with clear expectations and a culture that values honest input and follows through on decisions.

Start now

Your impact begins today. Why this role?

Application

Our company

We are a global provider of ocean-based freight services for bulk and project cargo of all sizes. We integrate freight solutions with port logistics, helping our customers optimise and decarbonise supply chains. We provide tailored solutions built on flexibility, reliability, and intelligence.

Our agile business model ensures stability by continuously adapting our fleet to market developments and customer needs.

Join us in this role where you’ll own and continuously develop our fundamental view of European power markets. Working at the intersection of market analysis and trading, you’ll bring together insights from across the organisation, form an independent view of where markets are heading, and translate this into clear commercial recommendations.

Working closely with the Trading & Revenue senior leadership, trading desk heads, and traders, you’ll influence decisions around trading strategies, hedging, portfolio management, and PPAs. Rather than supporting decisions from a distance, you’ll be a trusted market expert whose analysis and judgement help shape the positions we take.

**Welcome to Trading & Revenue

**You’ll be part of Forecasting & Analysis where you, together with your colleagues, will provide the market insights and analysis behind key trading and commercial decisions. You’ll work in a dynamic environment close to the trade floor, collaborating with traders, analysts, meteorologists, and dedicated in-house model developers. With strong modelling capabilities around you, you’ll be able to focus on interpreting what is happening in the market, challenging existing assumptions, forming a strong fundamental view, and translating it into commercial opportunities.

As a team, we challenge our thinking, share our expertise openly, and combine different perspectives to make better decisions.

In this role, your analysis becomes action. You’ll engage directly with Trading & Revenue senior leadership team and have the opportunity to shape how we understand European power markets. You’ll play a leading role in strengthening our market analysis capability, bringing in external perspectives and best practices, and developing a more integrated view across Trading & Revenue.

You’ll play an important role in:

• owning, developing, and maintaining our fundamental view of European power markets, with a particular focus on North-Western Europe and the UK, and bringing together perspectives from across Trading & Revenue into a coherent market outlook

• acting as a trusted sparring partner to the Trading & Revenue senior leadership, trading desk heads, traders, and portfolio managers, bringing an independent fundamental market perspective to key strategic and commercial decisions

• identifying structural and emerging shifts across supply, demand, regulation, weather, generation, interconnector flows, electrification, and other market drivers, and assessing what they mean for power prices and market dynamics

• turning market developments into commercial implications, from understanding the impact of changing generation availability or demand assumptions to assessing what these developments mean for our portfolios and trading positions

• translating fundamental market insights into actionable trading and hedging strategies together with our trading teams, helping facilitate discussions on what positions we should take as market conditions and assumptions evolve

• advising senior stakeholders on the market implications of important portfolio, PPA, and other commercial decisions, bringing a clear view of both market opportunities and risks

• advancing our fundamental power market capability by bringing together perspectives from across the organisation, introducing external insights and industry best practices, and strengthening how we form and communicate our market view across Trading & Revenue.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have deep expertise in European power markets and significant experience forming an independent view of how fundamental developments affect power prices and market dynamics

• bring strong commercial judgement and can move confidently from fundamental analysis to clear recommendations on trading, hedging, portfolio, and PPA decisions

• understand the interaction between physical power market fundamentals, forward markets, options, and curve dynamics, and can connect changes in the physical market with their commercial and trading implications

• are comfortable owning a market view, challenging established assumptions, and acting as an equal sparring partner to experienced traders and senior decision-makers

• can look beyond established market assumptions, identify developments or structural shifts that may not yet be fully reflected in the market view, and determine what they could mean for future power prices

• can bring together different sources of analysis, modelling, external intelligence, and perspectives from across the organisation to form a clear and coherent market view

• communicate complex market developments as concise, decisive, and commercially relevant recommendations, including to senior stakeholders

• bring substantial experience from power or closely related European energy markets, whether gained in a utility, trading environment, financial institution, or similar market-facing organization.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

At Autorola, we're transforming the global automotive industry through digital solutions, technology and business intelligence.

We're looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer to take technical ownership of a team's domain, guide architectural decisions and ensure high engineering quality across our software solutions.

You'll combine hands-on software development with technical leadership, working closely with Product Managers, engineers and other technical specialists to turn business needs into robust, scalable and maintainable solutions.

If you're passionate about software architecture, solving complex technical challenges and helping other engineers grow, we'd love to hear from you.

About us

The Autorola Group is a global leader in online vehicle remarketing, automotive IT solutions and business intelligence for the used vehicle market.

Through Autorola Marketplace, Autorola Solutions and Indicata, we help manufacturers, leasing companies, fleet owners and dealers buy, sell and manage vehicles more efficiently using technology, data and digital solutions.

Your role

As Staff Software Engineer, you'll be the team's technical anchor and go-to person, taking ownership of its technical direction, architecture and engineering standards.

You'll remain hands-on in software development while leading technical design discussions, making architectural decisions and guiding the team towards solutions that support both immediate business needs and long-term technical sustainability.

You'll work closely with the Team Lead, Product Manager, Principal Engineers and other department-level technical roles to align team decisions with Autorola's wider technology strategy.

Success means a well-architected and maintainable technical domain, high engineering standards, effective collaboration and a team that continues to grow technically.

What you'll be doing

• Take architectural ownership of the team's technical domain, including services, data models, interfaces, dependencies and technical documentation.

• Guide technical direction and ensure alignment with Autorola's architecture principles, engineering standards and technology strategy.

• Stay hands-on in software development, designing, building, testing and delivering high-quality solutions.

• Lead technical design discussions, reviews and decisions, making trade-offs between business needs, delivery speed and long-term maintainability.

• Drive modernisation initiatives, including breaking down legacy applications, improving system architecture and reducing duplication across teams.

• Collaborate with Principal Engineers and other Staff Engineers to align team architecture with company-wide strategies.

• Mentor and coach engineers, support technical problem-solving and help raise the overall engineering capabilities of the team.

• Promote best practices in automated testing, CI/CD, code reviews and responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

Who are we looking for

We're looking for a senior software engineer with deep technical expertise, strong architectural understanding and the ability to guide others through complex technical decisions. You are likely to have:

• A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering or similar, or equivalent practical experience.

• Typically, 8+ years of professional software development experience, including ownership of system architecture or a technical domain.

• Proven experience designing, building and operating production systems, including architecture, performance, security and monitoring.

• Experience modernising legacy applications and designing scalable, maintainable software architectures.

• Experience with cloud technologies, preferably AWS, and event-driven architecture.

• Strong knowledge of automated testing, CI/CD and code review practices.

• The ability to lead technical initiatives, make sound architectural decisions and communicate complex topics clearly to different stakeholders.

• Experience mentoring and coaching other engineers.

• Experience with technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, relational databases and AWS is relevant.

What success looks like

Within your first 12–18 months, you'll have:

• Established clear technical ownership of your team's domain, including architecture, services, dependencies and documentation.

• Built strong relationships with Product Management, Team Leads, Principal Engineers and other technical stakeholders.

• Guided the team towards consistent engineering standards and sustainable architectural decisions.

• Delivered visible progress on modernisation and reduced technical debt within your domain.

• Improved software quality, maintainability, scalability and operational reliability.

• Helped raise the technical capabilities of the team through mentoring, knowledge sharing and technical leadership.

• Contributed to aligning your team's technical direction with Autorola's wider technology strategy.

Why join Autorola Group?

Autorola Group is a global company with more than 850 employees across 20 subsidiaries in Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific.

You'll join an international technology environment where software engineering, business expertise and digital solutions come together to solve complex challenges for leading automotive companies.

As Staff Software Engineer, you'll have a significant influence on our technical direction, architectural decisions and engineering standards. You'll work alongside skilled engineers and technical specialists, with the opportunity to shape solutions, drive modernisation and help build the next generation of Autorola's technology platforms.

We also offer pension and health insurance, social and company events, a great lunch arrangement, access to a fitness room and a lively Friday bar.

Want to join the team?

We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible. Please note that this description reflects our ideal candidate profile. We strongly believe in inclusion and diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement. Applications and CVs will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the advertisement may be removed once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Christian Gless, Tech Talent Acquisition Partner, on csg@autorola.com.

Job Description

Are you interested in the intersection of IT, business and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will work with IT solutions supporting banks' corporate credit processes. You will analyze system issues, understand client needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions while building specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our team, working with IT solutions that support banks' corporate credit processes. You will be involved in the daily operation, maintenance and further development of these solutions, acting as a link between clients, developers and other stakeholders. Your work will involve investigating issues, understanding business needs and ensuring reliable system operations.

You will join an experienced team that will support your onboarding and help you build expertise within corporate credit and IT solutions. Initially, your focus will be on learning the existing solution and its daily operations, with opportunities to take on more responsibility for further development over time.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Handling and analyzing client-reported issues and tickets, investigating problems and identifying their root causes to ensure reliable system operations.

• Maintaining and supporting existing IT solutions while contributing to their continuous improvement and further development.

• Engaging in dialogue with clients to understand their needs and challenges, translating business requirements into clear and actionable tasks.

• Collaborating closely with developers and testers to investigate technical issues, clarify requirements and coordinate solutions.

• Supporting the development and implementation of new functionality through requirements analysis, testing and refinement.

About you

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how IT solutions work and how they support business processes. You enjoy investigating problems, asking questions and finding solutions in collaboration with others. You are comfortable communicating with different stakeholders and can translate complex issues into clear and actionable tasks.

We imagine that you have a relevant educational background and some experience working at the intersection of IT and business. Most importantly, you are eager to learn, take ownership and build specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

We imagine that you have:

• A relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it. or a similar degree combining IT, business, finance or accounting.

• Some experience from IT consulting, business analysis, application management, system support or a similar field. Recent graduates with a strong interest in IT and financial services are also welcome.

• Good analytical skills and an interest in investigating issues, understanding complex problems and identifying solutions.

• Technical understanding and an interest in IT systems, combined with an interest in banking, financial services or digitalisation. Experience with corporate credit, credit processes or financial statement analysis is an advantage, but not a requirement. Programming skills are not required.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English, spoken and written, is mandatory.

Join an inclusive community

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.
